strings.name: Filippo Grandi
strings.role: Humanitarian official · former UN High Commissioner for Refugees
strings.summary: Grandi entered international relief in the 1980s, working on refugees and recovery across Asia, the Middle East and Africa. He served as UN deputy special representative for Afghanistan and headed UNRWA before leading UNHCR from 2016 to 2025 through major displacement crises including Syria and Ukraine. He advocated refugee protection, international responsibility-sharing and sustained aid. His term ended in 2025, with Barham Salih succeeding him in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through long involvement in UN refugee affairs and service as high commissioner, he advances protection for displaced people and international aid.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied humanities in Milan and later philosophy in Rome; entered nongovernmental relief as a young adult.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Leading global refugee protection
strings.highlights.h1.text: High commissioner from 2016 to 2025, coordinating protection, assistance and shared international responsibility.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Humanitarian experience across regions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Worked on Afghanistan, Palestinian refugees and crises across Africa and Asia.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Ended term as high commissioner
strings.timeline.t1.text: His term ended; Barham Salih took office on January 1, 2026.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Received Olympic Laurel
strings.timeline.t2.text: Honored at the Paris Olympics opening ceremony for work linking refugee protection and sport.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Began extended term
strings.timeline.t3.text: Started a General Assembly-confirmed two-and-a-half-year extension ending December 31, 2025.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became high commissioner
strings.timeline.t4.text: Took leadership of UNHCR amid wars and large displacement crises.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Led UNRWA
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became commissioner-general of the UN agency for Palestine refugees, serving until 2014.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became UNRWA deputy commissioner-general
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from the Afghanistan mission to the agency’s deputy leadership.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Became deputy representative for Afghanistan
strings.timeline.t7.text: Served as UN deputy special representative in Afghanistan, working on postwar humanitarian affairs.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined UNHCR
strings.timeline.t8.text: Joined after early nongovernmental relief work, beginning a long international civil-service career.
